This page will host the code that reproduces the results of

> Pareek, S., Insolia, L., Molinari, R. & Guerrier, S. (2026). *Equivalence testing under privacy constraints*. arXiv preprint [arXiv:2604.06499](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06499).

The methods of this paper are available in the package through `tost_equiv_dp()` and `prop_test_equiv_dp()`; see the [Differential Privacy Equivalence Testing](dp-equivalence.html) article for their use.

*Reproduction code: coming soon.*
